verdict.rationale: CDP documents sending payouts and disbursements from a custodial account to onchain addresses, email recipients, or bank accounts over ACH, Fedwire, Swift, or SEPA, and funding a USD treasury to pay out USDC. Webhooks provide real-time event notifications that could track transfer status. However, nothing shows a batch or bulk payout endpoint that sends many payouts in one documented operation with per-item status, so mass disbursement appears to mean looping over single transfers. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk payout API, per-item status reporting within a batch, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
